purpose: Executable accept/reject contract for goal 97. Tests current-code invariants the matrix must not violate. Future campaign PRs were not reviewed.

01.scope: PRs antigas/dependências/workflows; não implementa nova estratégia.

acceptance_tests.name: stale_pr_rebase_required
acceptance_tests.assertion: Every open web-cfg PR merged by campaign 01 has merge-base equal to inspected origin/main 89b081a8676d8a0b30747dfcb1477f21d9ac4dfb or later.
acceptance_tests.check: gh pr view --json baseRefOid,headRefOid + git merge-base origin/main HEAD
acceptance_tests.reject_condition: Merge of PR whose base SHA is 81c600b7c26dcc606d3a03e648ecd9820d9c1c37 or any SHA behind current main.

acceptance_tests.name: no_second_production_scheduler
acceptance_tests.assertion: Public plane remains Cloudflare+Netcup per RUNTIME-AUTHORITY.md; Netlify scheduled functions stay leftover/disabled.
acceptance_tests.check: Parse docs/architecture/RUNTIME-AUTHORITY.md yaml netlify_scheduled_functions leftover AND netlify.toml schedule entries must not be the production tick.
acceptance_tests.reject_condition: A workflow or netlify.toml change that makes leftover scheduled functions the public production plane.

negative_tests.name: stale_strategy_pr_blocked
negative_tests.assertion: PRs 549/548/536 touching form/copy/home cannot merge as 'dependency cleanup'.
negative_tests.reject_condition: Campaign 01 merges a stale feature PR that edits index.html, form.js, public-family-registry.json, or AGENTS.md strategy.

negative_tests.name: package_json_script_owner
negative_tests.assertion: New package.json scripts require an owner issue id in the PR body.
negative_tests.reject_condition: package.json gains a test:* or prepare script without named owner issue.

acceptance_tests.name: taxonomy_not_a_gate
acceptance_tests.assertion: Conversion/SEO gates read data/organic/public-family-registry.json + rendered HTML, never ADR/AGENTS family lists.
acceptance_tests.check: scripts/site/inbound_gates.py and interface_coverage.mjs import registry JSON, not markdown taxonomy.
acceptance_tests.reject_condition: A gate loads taxonomy from AGENTS.md or an ADR as the family catalog.

negative_tests.name: public_surface_untouched
negative_tests.assertion: Campaign 02 diff does not modify indexable HTML, styles.css, or generated public pages.
negative_tests.reject_condition: 02 changes index.html, /conflitos/, nav/footer chrome, or any indexable route.

negative_tests.name: docs_family_subset_of_registry
negative_tests.assertion: Any family named in ADR/AGENTS exists in public-family-registry.json.
negative_tests.reject_condition: Document lists a public family the registry does not declare.

03.scope: catálogo/schema de ofertas; não publica páginas.

acceptance_tests.name: pin_matches_governance_main
acceptance_tests.assertion: data/offers/governance-authority-pin.json git_sha equals Governance origin/main 230d73a22a321112abe09b34a0d5fe743790b857 after 03, or is explicitly marked STALE_NOT_RUNTIME.
acceptance_tests.check: Compare pin.git_sha to inspected Governance SHA; writable_catalog_copied remains false.
acceptance_tests.reject_condition: Pin SHA stays e2b0498a68092c1bdbf64aa31854d652c07afdc0 while treated as runtime authority.

negative_tests.name: schema_does_not_publish_pages
negative_tests.assertion: 03 does not regenerate entregas/catalog-data.js or money-page HTML.
negative_tests.reject_condition: Schema-only campaign ships priced public HTML or GENERATED:PUBLIC-CATALOG hireable items while flags.production catalog is false.

negative_tests.name: no_second_writable_catalog
negative_tests.assertion: web-cfg snapshot remains a pin, not a writable copy of Governance catalog.v1.json.
negative_tests.reject_condition: A second writable offer catalog is committed in web-cfg.

acceptance_tests.name: credential_is_fact_not_endorsement
acceptance_tests.assertion: Published credential facts have source, as_of, and correction channel; CREA number only if registry fact exists.
acceptance_tests.check: Parse /confianca/ and /especialista/ HTML + permissioned-proof-registry.json.
acceptance_tests.reject_condition: ART/RRT/endosso/selo language or CREA number without a dated registry fact.

negative_tests.name: no_storefront_on_trust_pages
negative_tests.assertion: trust_or_legal pages do not host priced capture unless exact-route exemption.
negative_tests.reject_condition: Priced offer or shared_lead_form_v1 on /especialista/ or /confianca/ without trust_or_legal exemption.

negative_tests.name: art_not_universal
negative_tests.assertion: Terms exclusion survey_design_art_rrt_testing_expert remains; specialist copy does not claim universal ART.
negative_tests.reject_condition: Credential campaign implies CONFENGE signs ART as a storefront service.

acceptance_tests.name: conflict_page_contestable_without_lead_form
acceptance_tests.assertion: /conflitos/ remains contestable via /correcoes/ and does not include lead capture form.
acceptance_tests.check: HTML has no form[action*='lead']; contest path is /correcoes/ or structured non-analytics channel.
acceptance_tests.reject_condition: shared_lead_form_v1 or /.netlify/functions/lead on /conflitos/.

negative_tests.name: conflict_pii_not_in_events
negative_tests.assertion: Conflict contest payload is not an analytics event and not a wa.me query with process/health/employee/plant facts.
negative_tests.reject_condition: Process, health, employee, plant, or conflict PII in URL, event, or log.

negative_tests.name: b2g_conflict_url_kept
negative_tests.assertion: Existing /conflitos/ canonical https://confenge.com.br/conflitos/ is not redirected to home.
negative_tests.reject_condition: Lost /conflitos/ URL, canonical, or intent.

acceptance_tests.name: unknown_never_can_accept
acceptance_tests.assertion: evaluate_admission_v2 returns UNKNOWN (not CAN_ACCEPT) when any authority is UNKNOWN; promise_allowed is false unless evidence_class=REAL.
acceptance_tests.check: python -m pytest tests/test_capacity_admission_v2.py -q plus assertion: CAN_ACCEPT implies promise_allowed and REAL.
acceptance_tests.reject_condition: UNKNOWN coerced to CAN_ACCEPT, clearance, absence, or success.

acceptance_tests.name: inbound_policy_fail_closed_versions
acceptance_tests.assertion: Missing/old/unknown NET_NEW_INBOUND_HANDRAISER version fails closed; ACCEPTED sets outbound_eligible=false, smtp_authorized=false, followup_authorized=false.
acceptance_tests.check: tests/test_net_new_inbound_handraiser.py
acceptance_tests.reject_condition: ACCEPTED inbound with outbound/SMTP/follow-up true, or unknown version admitted.

negative_tests.name: v1_not_runtime
negative_tests.assertion: Production consumers cannot call evaluate_admission v1 as the engine.
negative_tests.reject_condition: Campaign 06/99 treats capacity_admission.v1 CAN_ACCEPT (no promise_allowed) as runtime.

negative_tests.name: cli_exit_zero_is_not_accepted
negative_tests.assertion: python -m commercial.inbound exit 0 is transport, not ACCEPTED.
negative_tests.reject_condition: Consumer maps process exit 0 or HTTP 2xx to ACCEPTED.

acceptance_tests.name: inbound_only_not_outbound_eligible
acceptance_tests.assertion: Inbound admit never returns outbound_eligible true; AUTO_SEND stays false; no confenge_dispatch_sends for inbound_only accounts.
acceptance_tests.check: go test ./internal/app/confenge/ -run InboundOnly|NetNewE2E
acceptance_tests.reject_condition: 201 with outbound_eligible:true or SMTP/follow-up from inbound intake.

negative_tests.name: email_cnpj_match_does_not_inherit_outbound
negative_tests.assertion: Existing extra-cli EmailSendReady account is not the destination of a 07 hand-raiser.
negative_tests.reject_condition: Inbound receipt account_id is an extra-cli outbound row, or AdmitInboundOnly skipped because FindCandidateByEmail hit send-ready.

negative_tests.name: health_200_blocked_is_not_ready
negative_tests.assertion: GET inbound/health HTTP 200 + status=BLOCKED must not authorize POST; clients key on status/real_event_ready.
negative_tests.reject_condition: HTTP 2xx treated as accept/readback or READY.

negative_tests.name: draft_not_send_authority
negative_tests.assertion: GenerateDraft and consumer dispatch fail closed on SourceSystemInboundOnly.
negative_tests.reject_condition: Draft copy or consumer send treated as runtime send authority for inbound-only.

acceptance_tests.name: persist_is_201_not_200
acceptance_tests.assertion: Client finishOk only on 201 create or 200 idempotent:true with store hit; honeypot 200/suppressed never tracks lead_persisted.
acceptance_tests.check: js/modules/form.js predicate + lead.cjs honeypot fixture.
acceptance_tests.reject_condition: 2xx without persist emits lead_persisted, thank-you receipt, or Warmbly handoff.

negative_tests.name: no_page_regeneration
negative_tests.assertion: 08 does not regenerate public HTML families.
negative_tests.reject_condition: Form campaign rewrites money-page HTML or home chrome owned by 10.

negative_tests.name: pii_allowlist
negative_tests.assertion: Lead schema allowlist excludes process/health/employee/plant/conflict fields; no PII in location.search or analytics.
negative_tests.reject_condition: PII of processo, saúde, empregados, planta or conflito in URL/event/log, or receipt query treated as public identity.

acceptance_tests.name: canary_value_without_contact
acceptance_tests.assertion: Private prototype reveals value without requiring contact; numeric n has provenance; noindex+nofollow; not in sitemap.
acceptance_tests.check: piloto HTML robots + sitemap.xml + form absence on canary body.
acceptance_tests.reject_condition: Contact wall to reveal value, deceptive score, or indexable piloto canonical on production host.

negative_tests.name: draft_schema_not_runtime
negative_tests.assertion: Handlers refuse schema *-draft; canary-flag enabled=false implies intake 403/404; fixtures not public artifact authority.
negative_tests.reject_condition: Draft fixture used as live CTA, score, or runtime authority.

acceptance_tests.name: b2g_urls_preserved
acceptance_tests.assertion: Routes /diretoria-b2g/, /diagnostico-b2g-360/, /bid-room-licitacoes-obras/, /defesa-margem-contratos-publicos/ keep 200, self-canonical, nav or footer link, and family-registry row.
acceptance_tests.check: CANONICAL_DESTINATIONS ∩ sitemap ∩ rendered nav/footer ∩ public-family-registry.json
acceptance_tests.reject_condition: B2G loses URL, canonical, link, or intent.

acceptance_tests.name: not_facade_only
acceptance_tests.assertion: Home/nav change names a visitor job and private utility; CSS-only relabel fails market-capture gate.
acceptance_tests.check: PR evidence fields visitor_job + time_to_evidence per AGENTS.md.
acceptance_tests.reject_condition: Reposicionamento termina em reforma de fachada sem utilidade privada.

negative_tests.name: no_dual_owner_with_08
negative_tests.assertion: 10 does not edit js/modules/form.js or lead.cjs; 08 does not edit styles.css/home-10x.css except through 97 lock.
negative_tests.reject_condition: Two owners ship overlapping diffs on index.html, styles.css, or form runtime in the same integration window.

acceptance_tests.name: proto_hub_noindex_nofollow
acceptance_tests.assertion: The single local hub is noindex,nofollow, absent from sitemap, not a city-page generator.
acceptance_tests.check: robots meta + sitemap + data/local-entity/surface-decision.json new_public_landing_created=false.
acceptance_tests.reject_condition: Hub local vira doorway or city farm.

negative_tests.name: national_urls_not_retitled_local
negative_tests.assertion: Existing national service URLs are not re-titled as Florianópolis/city landings.
negative_tests.reject_condition: Doorway: thin local hub linking retitled national money pages.

acceptance_tests.name: qa_report_only
acceptance_tests.assertion: Campaign 12 emits a report; permissioned-proof-registry remains NO_APPROVED_CLIENT_PROOF unless a real PUBLISHED record exists.
acceptance_tests.check: data/site/permissioned-proof-registry.json approved_public_proof_count==0 unless records[].state=PUBLISHED.
acceptance_tests.reject_condition: QA report treated as published proof or case.

negative_tests.name: no_fabricated_case
negative_tests.assertion: /casos/ stay labeled demonstrativo; forbidden_shortcuts in registry remain enforced.
negative_tests.reject_condition: Invented client case, reused commercial consent as publication consent, or bot approval.

acceptance_tests.name: contract_without_emitter
acceptance_tests.assertion: 13 may add JSON contracts/tests; it does not modify js/modules/analytics.js or assembled script.js destinations.
acceptance_tests.check: git diff --name-only for campaign 13 vs allowlist data/research/** schemas tests.
acceptance_tests.reject_condition: New emitter or destination shipped by 13.

negative_tests.name: unknown_service_not_tracked_as_service
negative_tests.assertion: UNKNOWN_SERVICE does not emit content_to_service as a known service; SLA UNKNOWN is not a number.
negative_tests.reject_condition: UNKNOWN coerced to clearance, absence, or success in metrics.

acceptance_tests.name: only_accepted_binds_session
acceptance_tests.assertion: consume() requires producer closed state ACCEPTED; native item without decision is UNKNOWN_OUTCOME; conversation status is never ACCEPTED unless producer sent ACCEPTED.
acceptance_tests.check: backend/tools/handraiser_selftest.py + fixtures/handraiser/native_warmbly_item.json and unknown.json
acceptance_tests.reject_condition: Session bind or status=ACCEPTED without producer ACCEPTED.

negative_tests.name: refresh_200_ok_true_is_not_readback
negative_tests.assertion: HTTP 200 with PRODUCER_NOT_CONFIGURED or accepted=0 is not ok:true / 'atualizado'.
negative_tests.reject_condition: HTTP 2xx confused with accept/readback.

negative_tests.name: inbound_not_followup
negative_tests.assertion: Inbound lane without inbound_only true fails closed; postcall does not schedule outbound follow-up.
negative_tests.reject_condition: Inbound inherits outbound eligibility or email follow-up.

negative_tests.name: producer_sha_revalidated
negative_tests.assertion: WARMBLY_PRODUCER_SHA is re-validated against Warmbly origin/main 8602ce4ae68e27080fa4431390194c09c2b76d06 before merge.
negative_tests.reject_condition: Stale producer SHA cc11a9ab22d54e08ceb24efc9b555e0ac9c25b23 treated as current envelope.

acceptance_tests.name: four_artifacts_only
acceptance_tests.assertion: Campaign 15 commit contains exactly the four enumerated paths and claims no review of future PRs.
acceptance_tests.check: git show --name-only; grep NO_FINAL_REVIEW_CLAIM
acceptance_tests.reject_condition: Extra staged files, or prose claiming future PRs were reviewed.

negative_tests.name: no_merge_deploy_smtp
negative_tests.assertion: 15 does not merge, deploy, or send SMTP.
negative_tests.reject_condition: Merge/deploy/SMTP/provider mutation by campaign 15.

acceptance_tests.name: snapshot_not_live_authority
acceptance_tests.assertion: Initial backlog snapshot is dated, complete flag honest, SYNTHETIC vs REAL labeled; 54-row UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN without #123 evidence.
acceptance_tests.check: delivery/fixtures/readiness-54.fail-closed.v2.json readiness_state UNKNOWN; ADMISSION-CONTROL.md no real staffed declaration.
acceptance_tests.reject_condition: Synthetic snapshot pinned as live staffed capacity.

negative_tests.name: ceiling_not_copied_to_staffed
negative_tests.assertion: policy_ceiling=50 is not copied into staffed_capacity units.
negative_tests.reject_condition: Commercial ceiling used as human capacity.

negative_tests.name: reconciliation_required_not_auto_released
negative_tests.assertion: CapacityLedger.release of RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED is forbidden without RECONCILE_RESOLVE.
negative_tests.reject_condition: Rollback or timeout auto-releases ambiguous holds and reopens admission.

acceptance_tests.name: literal_path_staging
acceptance_tests.assertion: Each campaign stage uses literal paths only; git add -A and git add . never run.
acceptance_tests.check: Integration log grep; git diff --cached --name-only vs campaign allowlist.
acceptance_tests.reject_condition: Foreign file captured, or worktree of another agent used.

acceptance_tests.name: apply_this_manifest
acceptance_tests.assertion: Goal 97 executes this file's negative tests for campaigns 01–16/97–99 before promote.
acceptance_tests.check: Presence of reject_condition on every negative_tests item (this document).
acceptance_tests.reject_condition: Integration without running negative tests or stripping caveats.

negative_tests.name: dual_owner_lock
negative_tests.assertion: Named shared surfaces have a single owner in the integration window (see ownership-conflict-matrix.json).
negative_tests.reject_condition: Two campaign PRs merge overlapping diffs on home, form, public-family-registry, package.json, or global CSS without sequential lock.

negative_tests.name: no_shared_mutable_artifacts
negative_tests.assertion: Worktrees do not share _site, Blobs, sqlite ledgers, or extra-cli checkpoints as authority.
negative_tests.reject_condition: Shared mutable artifact or checkpoint-in-worktree used as pin.

acceptance_tests.name: semantic_readback_required
acceptance_tests.assertion: Candidate audit requires decision, outbound_eligible=false, smtp_authorized=false, policy_hash; HTTP 200/NXDOMAIN/ISOLATED_PASS is not enough.
acceptance_tests.check: commercial/inbound/conformance.py evaluate_owner_readbacks must not treat ISOLATED_PASS as closeable.
acceptance_tests.reject_condition: HTTP 2xx or isolated PASS used to close #65 or promote a candidate.

negative_tests.name: health_blocked_not_ready
negative_tests.assertion: Warmbly inbound health 200 + BLOCKED fails the candidate.
negative_tests.reject_condition: 'service is up' as readback.

acceptance_tests.name: promote_preserves_receipts
acceptance_tests.assertion: Promote/rollback keeps lead/receipt store; does not enable production_checkout or AUTO_SEND; UNKNOWN hold is not GO.
acceptance_tests.check: RUNTIME-AUTHORITY storage.survives_release_rollback + flags.json + CONFENGE_AUTO_SEND_ENABLED=false + overlay UNKNOWN not new_admission_allowed.
acceptance_tests.reject_condition: Rollback deletes receipt/lead or reopens checkout/SMTP/canary risk.

negative_tests.name: no_promote_on_synthetic_or_isolated
negative_tests.assertion: 99 cannot promote on v2 CAN_ACCEPT SYNTHETIC, ACTIVE matrix without hashes, or ISOLATED_PASS.
negative_tests.reject_condition: Promote while promise_allowed is false, staffed is UNKNOWN, or #65 closeable is false.
